events.htmlDescription:
PREZZO ITALIAN 30 PERCENT OFF TOTAL BILL OFFER


We have partnered up for the Autumn with Prezzo Italian Kingston to offer customers booking any event at the Rose Theatre the opportunity to get 30 percent off their total bill when dining in the restaurant

Only one voucher needed per booking.

Just add to your ticket order or simply present your show tickets on arrival at the restaurant on the corresponding date.

To avoid disappointment, we recommend you pre book a table via their website.

Prezzo Italian Kingston is located at The Malthouse, 25 29 High St, Kingston upon Thames KT1 1LL and within a few minutes walk of the Rose Theatre on the opposite side of the street. Your restaurant booking must be on the same day as the show you are attending.

events.htmlDescription:
Get an exclusive discount when booking a standard Turks boat trip


Make your theatre experience even more memorable with 25 percent off a boat trip with Turks Cruises when you book your theatre ticket.

Add the Turks offer voucher to your basket when purchasing your theatre ticket to obtain the code. Can be booked at any time but please be aware this offer is subject to availability so please book in good time.

Book your boat trip tickets at bookings.turks.co.uk, enter code at checkout and get ready to set sail!

Offer applicable alongside any event booked on the Rose website between now and 1 Nov. Offer only available on advanced bookings and can't be accepted in person on the day. Boat trip does not need to be taken on the same day as booked show. Trip available on select days see Turks website for more details.
